$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for this file.

provider.description: Tunnel provider: "opentunnel" (default) or "cloudflared" (needs the cloudflared binary on PATH; see the `cloudflared` section).

port.description: Local port to expose through the tunnel. Default: 5173.

host.description: Local host the tunnel forwards to. Default: "localhost" (resolves to ::1 or 127.0.0.1 — vite preview often binds IPv6 only).

profile.description: Identity-store profile: the name of the stored tunnel record, whichever provider wrote it. Defaults to the project directory name. A stable profile keeps the public URL stable across runs (reset with `vkma-tunnel reset`).

opentunnel.description: Options of the opentunnel provider; only meaningful with provider: "opentunnel".

route.description: Route name: "@" (apex, https://<id>.opentunnel.xyz) or a lowercase DNS label for a subdomain. Default: "@".

api.description: API endpoint of a self-hosted opentunnel server, e.g. "https://opentunnel.example". Optional; the opentunnel client also honors the OPENTUNNEL_API env var.

cloudflared.description: Options of the cloudflared provider; only meaningful with provider: "cloudflared".

mode.description: "quick": a one-time trycloudflare.com URL without an account — the hostname changes on every start. "token": a named tunnel created in the Cloudflare dashboard, stable hostname.

hostname.description: Token mode: the public hostname configured in the dashboard for this tunnel, e.g. "app.example.com".

token.description: Token mode: the dashboard's tunnel token. Prefer the TUNNEL_TOKEN environment variable — never commit a token.

protocol.description: Transport to the Cloudflare edge. "http2" (default) also works where UDP 7844 is blocked; "quic" is faster but keeps dying on such networks.

binary.description: The cloudflared executable: a name looked up on PATH (default "cloudflared"), an absolute path, or a path relative to the project: the config file's directory, or the working directory (the Vite root for the plugin) when a flag or an option names it.
